cost_protocol.IR_IVM_prefix: all formally reportable R6B states at or below N_F=20000
cost_protocol.ODE_NEB_history: current accepted path after each paid batch; rejected paid trials retain the preceding current path
cost_protocol.curve: strict cumulative-best first-passage frontier; no metric or N_F interpolation

metric_protocol.delta_e: max(E_0,...,E_31)-E_0 on the same stored 32-image path

geometric_action.force_identity: stored OpenMM Force=-grad V, so Euclidean norms agree
geometric_action.name: discrete action

metric_protocol.i_perp: central-difference tangent; normal full Force; local Cartesian Voronoi weights
